title: AI for Small Business Owners
subtitle: How to Use ChatGPT and AI Tools to Automate the Work You Hate, Reclaim Ten Hours a Week, and Grow Without Hiring
author: Jordan Vale
description_html:
Stop doing work a machine can do. Most small business owners lose ten hours a week to the same patterned tasks: enquiry replies, quotes, follow-ups, invoices, social posts, paperwork. This book shows you exactly which of those hours a machine can take back - and which work must stay yours.

Written for skeptical, time-poor owners, not technologists, it gives you a step-by-step ninety-day plan: the three-day audit that finds your ten hours, the prompting skill that makes AI output actually usable, ready workflows for customer messages, marketing, quotes and the back office, your first hands-off automation, and the boundary rules that keep your customers' data and your reputation safe.

No hype. No jargon. One action per week, with the honest numbers behind every claim. If you can follow instructions and send a message, you can run everything in this book.
